title: Hyperscale AI Data Center Efficiency
summary: Next-generation AI data centers achieving PUE overhead of 10-20% (vs 40-50% in legacy facilities)...
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Next-generation AI data centers achieving PUE overhead of 10-20% (vs 40-50% in legacy facilities) through immersion cooling, direct liquid cooling, and optimised power distribution.. Achieved.

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Modern hyperscale AI data centers: 10-20% overhead from cooling/power distribution vs 40-50% in older facilities. IEA: widespread AI adoption could deliver 13 EJ energy savings by 2035. Allianz Research 2026.
